label: Restrict shell access
description: Removes terminal access and arbitrary command execution (KRunner, Dolphin's Open Terminal) and disables the user's autostart folder.
windowsEquivalent: Prevent access to the command prompt

label: Restrict KRunner command execution
description: Disables KRunner (Alt+F2 / Alt+Space). The desktop menu entry is hidden as well (action/run_command is written with the same value).
windowsEquivalent: Remove Run menu from Start Menu

label: Restrict logout, shutdown and restart
description: Removes the leave actions from the launcher and the desktop menu (action/logout is written with the same value). Combine with Lock desktop layout for kiosk desktops.
windowsEquivalent: Remove and prevent access to the Shut Down, Restart, Sleep, and Hibernate commands

label: Restrict locking the screen
description: Removes the Lock Screen action from menus and shortcuts.

label: Restrict user switching
description: Removes the Switch User action.
windowsEquivalent: Hide entry points for Fast User Switching

label: Restrict starting a new session
description: Removes the New Session action (a second graphical login).

label: Restrict the password reveal button
description: Password fields no longer offer to show the typed text.
windowsEquivalent: Do not display the password reveal button

label: Restrict text completion in input fields
description: Input fields stop remembering and suggesting earlier entries. Recommended on shared and public terminals.

label: Lock toolbars in place
description: Toolbars of KDE applications cannot be moved.

label: Restrict running untrusted .desktop files
description: Only .desktop files from the system application, menu, service and autostart locations can be run.

label: Restrict Get New... downloads
description: Disables the Get New Themes / Wallpapers / Widgets dialogs that download from store.kde.org.

label: Restrict the --config command line option
description: Applications ignore a user-supplied configuration file on the command line.

label: Restrict bypassing document restrictions (Okular)
description: Users cannot override copy and print restrictions embedded in PDF documents.

label: Restrict Open With...
description: Removes the Open With dialog, which can start arbitrary programs.

windowsEquivalent: Lock the taskbar; Prevent users from customizing their Start Screen
